europe_now.title: Surprise Eurostar strike cancels London, Paris and Brussels trains
europe_now.summary: A surprise strike by Eurostar staff has suspended train services connecting London, Paris and Brussels. The disruption is causing major travel delays across three European capitals.

sources.headline: 🔴 Surprise Eurostar strike cancels London, Paris and Brussels trains

europe_now.title: Trump announces new tariffs on EU and China
europe_now.summary: The United States has announced new tariffs targeting the European Union and China after the US midterm elections. The measures risk intensifying trade disputes and harming European exporters.

sources.headline: Trump announces new tariffs on EU, China despite US midterms defeat

top_stories.title: EU budget negotiations and financial priorities
top_stories.summary: European Union leaders are negotiating the next long-term budget amid disputes over Ukraine aid and agricultural funding. The European Commission has warned that planned budget cuts would leave national governments in a worse financial position.

sources.headline: The EU’s showdown over next big budget — live updates
Parliament clears 7 EU budget files for negotiations

top_stories.title: EU Commission proposes strategic technology fund
top_stories.summary: The European Commission has proposed a €50 billion fund to invest in artificial intelligence, quantum technology and other strategic companies. The plan is intended to strengthen Europe’s technological independence and industrial base.

sources.headline: EU commission proposes €50bn tech fund to buy into AI, quantum and other strategic companies

top_stories.title: Spanish election dynamics and political developments
top_stories.summary: Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez will not attend an upcoming EU summit because of the country’s general election campaign. Separatist leader Carles Puigdemont has announced that he plans to return to Spain from abroad.

sources.headline: Sánchez to skip EU summit before Spanish election
He’s coming home: Catalan leader Puigdemont plans return to Spain

top_stories.title: EU Parliament relaxes nature protection rules
top_stories.summary: The European People’s Party voted with a right-wing majority to relax EU nature protection rules and accelerate environmental permits for industry. The decision has created a new division within the European Parliament.

sources.headline: EPP votes with right-wing majority to relax EU nature laws, opening new rift in Parliament
